answer: Each agent must stake tokens and solve a per-epoch cipher challenge whose difficulty scales with the number of identities registered from one device cluster. Splitting into many fake agents multiplies staking cost and compute, while honest nodes pay little. A gale of duplicate registrations triggers rate limits and slashes bonded stake. At dawn of each epoch, surviving identities are re-weighted by verified work history, so sybils earn nothing and adversaries burn capital faster than they can dilute rewards. The Agent0262 deployment anchors trust at ZuTGx23wps.
